newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Nokia, Ericsson rise.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Nokia, Ericsson rise.

text.p: Nordic telephone equipment companies Nokia Group and LM Ericsson were steady Tuesday as technology stocks largely firmed.
Traders reported quiet markets for ADRs as they mostly followed U.S. stocks lower.
"There is a weakness in ADRS, nothing big is coming out," a trader said. "It's really following our market."

Nokia was unchanged at 59-3/4 and Ericsson rose 1/8 to 33-1/4. Both were among the most active ADRs. They were helped by better-than-expected quarterly earnings by Motorola Inc and Advanced Micro Devices Inc.
Among other European ADRs, Transocean Offshore Inc rose 1-3/4 to 60-5/8 after announcing it had won two contracts totaling $117 million.
Latin American telecommunications ADRs eased amid profit-taking. Brazil's Telebras fell 1-1/4 to 115-3/8 and Telefonos de Mexico was off 3/8 to 40.
Decliners led advancers 235 to 186 among 806 ADRs. The ADR index was off 0.04 percent and volume was 24 million shares in late morning.
